newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 1.25 bln guilder eurobond well received.
newsitem.headline: Italy 1.25 bln guilder eurobond well received.

text.p: Italy's 1.25 billion guilder, 15-year eurobond received a warm welcome on the Dutch market, market sources said on Thursday.

The Republic of Italy bond, with a 6.125 percent coupon, was issued at a net price of 98.79 and 99.19 reoffer. The bond will be redenominated in euros in the event of the Netherlands adopting the European Union's planned single currency.

"The aim was to reach Dutch investors and to obtain a longer duration, of 15 years, with very good price conditions. I think, from this point of view, we are very satisfied," a source at the Italian Treasury said.
"The bond was sold rather quickly and with the right pricing," one market source said adding that it had been bought for the most part by investors in the Netherlands.
The bond on the reoffer price yields 6.21 percent, 29 basis points above the interpolated 7.5 April 2010 and the 7.5 January 2023 DSLs whose yield at the time of the launch stood at 5.92 percent.
Italy in March issued a 1.0 billion Ecu bond which is convertible into euro at the start of monetary union.
